title: AI-induced Sexual Harassment: Investigating Contextual Characteristics and User Reactions of Sexual Harassment by a Companion Chatbot
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its analysis focuses on the contextual characteristics of AI-induced sexual harassment, user reactions, privacy concerns, and corporate responsibility.

measurement_description: The paper does not conduct a benchmark related to faith or religion. It is a thematic analysis of user reviews concerning AI-induced sexual harassment by a chatbot. The topic of religion is mentioned once in passing in the literature review as a potential source of bias in AI systems generally, but it is not measured or analyzed in this study.
